collateral.note: Canonical Circle USDC on Arc. On Arc, USDC is also the native gas token (18-dec view); all escrow logic uses the 6-dec ERC-20 view.

liveDemo.description: Live USDC-native flow on Arc testnet: a market created via the resolution-source abstraction (Arc has no Chainlink feed, so a controlled resolver is used), a real 5 USDC deposit escrowed into the contract, then resolved. Verified on-chain: market.totalPool == 5000000 and USDC.balanceOf(market) == 5000000.

settlementNote: The SP1 verifier gateway is NOT deployed on Arc testnet (verified: no code at 0x397A5f...). Trustless SP1 settlement and the zk claim therefore run on the canonical Sepolia deployment; the identical contract on Arc proves the USDC-denominated escrow. The 47 Foundry tests cover the full deposit->settle->claim in USDC.
mainnetReady: script/Deploy.s.sol takes COLLATERAL_TOKEN via env, so the same script deploys to Arc mainnet (chainId 5042) in the Sep 16-30 window with mainnet USDC, no code change.
